texts:
Parts Studio is live on three.ws. Give it the URL of a 3D model and it splits the mesh into named parts, cutting at disconnected shells and concave creases, so each piece can be isolated, hidden or exported on its own.

In the reel, a mannequin comes back as 24 parts, found from the geometry alone.

Agents get the same tool: segment_model over MCP, and a plain REST endpoint at /api/forge-segment. The segmentation worker runs on Google Cloud Run.

Try it on your own model: three.ws/segment
